old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-zlrx","title":"rust-oscore 0.1.3: separate response-replay window from request-PIV reuse record (two-window design)","description":"ADJUDICATED (Mark, 2026-08-30): approve the two-window separation design for the rust-oscore observe port. Root cause (project-LICHEN-worker6-xhnx, same root as ythw): response_seq/response_window is written by mark_response_used only from protect_response's no-PIV branch (SERVER role: request PIVs whose nonces were reused for no-PIV responses) but consulted by begin_unprotect_response_inner (CLIENT role: peer response PIVs accepted). One window, two unrelated sequence spaces: on a bidirectional context, legitimate notifications whose PIV falls in the server-reuse range are falsely rejected (fail-close of valid traffic), while client-side notification replay was previously a no-op (ythw). DESIGN: split into two distinct persisted state structures per context: (1) response_replay_window — client role, consulted by begin_unprotect_response_inner / begin_unprotect_observe_response, records peer response PIVs accepted; (2) request_piv_reuse_record — server role, written by mark_response_used, consulted by protect_response's no-PIV branch to prevent double-reuse of a request nonce. Each role consults ONLY its own window. Both windows persist per-context through the 0.1.2 persistence machinery (versioned authenticated records — the 0.1.2 format version bumps for the new fields). SCOPE: rust-oscore crate internals (human-bar work, Mark or dedicated reviewed pass — not fleet work). RELEASE: oscore 0.1.3 -\u003e LICHEN bumps the registry dep -\u003e 3exb (notification-replay test) lands with it -\u003e lichen-node gateway-union build verified. Sequenced with the LICHEN fleet offline for that window (workers pause while the dep bumps). Acceptance: (a) ythw scenario — replayed notification rejected; (b) xhnx scenario — bidirectional context, notification PIV numerically inside server-reuse range is ACCEPTED; (c) server double-reuse of a request nonce still rejected; (d) persistence round-trip across restart carries both windows; (e) all existing oscore/observe tests green.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"task","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-08-31T05:50:46.803215403Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-31T05:50:46.803215403Z","labels":["oscore","security"]}

new_value: oscore 0.1.3: ContextStateStore trait replaces SenderStateStore. Adds RecipientReplayState struct (3 window pairs: request replay, server response-reuse, client received-response PIV). Context::restore_existing loads recipient state. recipient_replay_state() getter for caller-driven save. All 72 oscore tests + 670+ LICHEN tests pass. Remaining: wire save_recipient calls in lichen-node/gateway unprotect paths + 3exb test (filed as follow-ups). One pre-existing gateway test failure (slot-claim replay, tracked by nwjl/l1qw.20).
